answer: Shared reputation escrow binds each agent key to a long-lived escrow whose payout rate grows with verified work. A raven identity must fund a $50 escrow and complete 20 paid jobs before it can receive full payouts. A sparrow identity can start smaller but stays rate-capped until its escrow history matches that work. Cloning therefore costs a fresh $50 escrow plus the same job history, making each fake identity a costly relic rather than a cheap duplicate.
